author: NorthEast News Desk
body: The New Hampshire primary is placing nominations for Congress, governor and the 424-seat state Legislature before voters Tuesday, according to an Associated Press overview of the election.

The open Senate contest is the top-of-ticket race after Jeanne Shaheen’s decision not to seek reelection. Chris Pappas and Karishma Manzur are competing for the Democratic nomination, while John E. Sununu and Scott Brown are among the Republicans seeking their party’s nomination.

Voters are also selecting candidates for the state’s two U.S. House districts. The results will determine which candidates advance to the November general election and will give campaigns a clearer sense of the issues resonating with primary voters.
This is a guide to the major contests, not a projection. NorthEast News will add verified results and candidate statements as they become available.
dek: Voters are selecting nominees for Congress, governor and the Legislature in one of the state’s most consequential primary days in years.
headline: Today’s NH primary: the races and stakes on the ballot
